hauska-map.the contract: packages/parcel-fact-sheet/src/index.ts BuildableEnvelope is a discriminated union with exactly three variants today (derived/consumed/not-derived), each consumed via `env.kind ===` narrowing in fact-sheet-resolver.ts, sheet-to-card-model.ts (bakedCardModelFromSheet AND envelopeStateFromSheet), and the verdict composer's envelopeSegment(). Adding a fourth `modelled` variant and letting TypeScript's exhaustiveness checking surface every non-updated call site (via tsc --noEmit) was the plan, rather than grepping for every consumer by hand.
hauska-map.sheetEnvelopeIsAtomPathPending: fact-sheet-resolver.ts:238-254. Detects live-derive geometry (disclosure contains 'live derive', or a geojson feature carries properties.source==='live-derive'). envelopeValue() (line ~1927) currently returns kind:'not-derived' unconditionally whenever this is true -- Ruling B's original mechanism (P-91 O1). Plan: when true AND ringsFromGeoJson(env.geojson) is non-empty AND setbacksUsed exists, return the new 'modelled' kind instead; otherwise (no geometry at all -- the negative-control shape) keep returning 'not-derived' exactly as today. This leaves the no-district negative control (48453:474034) provably untouched, since it never has geometry to begin with.
hauska-map.map draw mechanism: envelope-overlay.ts's normalizeEnvelope() only inspects `status` and geometry presence on the CardEnvelopeState the card hands ExplorerMap.handleEnvelope -- it does not look at buildableAreaSqFt/Pct at all. Confirmed by reading normalizeEnvelope() in full: kind:'ok' requires status!=='declined', not empty, and a real Polygon under geometry/geojson. So making envelopeStateFromSheet() return status:'ok' + geometry (mirroring the existing 'derived' branch) for the new 'modelled' kind, while omitting `summary` entirely (no field to read a figure from), is sufficient to make the map draw -- no change needed to envelope-overlay.ts or ExplorerMap.tsx itself.
hauska-map.entitlement gate: ExplorerMap.tsx handleEnvelope: `const mayDraw = snap != null && isEntitled(snap)` gates the actual setEnvelopeOverlays call, independent of normalizeEnvelope's kind. isEntitled = isPro(s) || s.propertyUnlocked || s.devRole (entitlementClient.ts:97-99). NOT touched. Recording for the close: the modelled polygon will be visible to Pro / property-unlocked / dev-role sessions, suppressed for Free, exactly the same gate the existing 'derived' envelope already uses -- this ruling does not change who sees a drawing, only what an entitled session sees for an atom-pending parcel.
hauska-map.Buildable row text: bakedCardModelFromSheet's buildablePct ternary (sheet-to-card-model.ts ~line 750) currently falls through to a bare `absent()` (no message) for the not-derived/atom_path_pending case when setbacks are present, and InspectCard.tsx's toFactPresentation (line ~493-497) prints the fallback 'Not stamped here' whenever an absent CardFacet carries no message. Plan: for the new 'modelled' kind, call mapBuildableDisplay from buildable-display-vocab.ts (the module's own stated invariant is that surfaces MUST call it rather than re-deriving copy -- bakedCardModelFromSheet currently does NOT follow that invariant for any of its branches, a pre-existing gap not in this mission's scope to fully close, but the new branch will follow it) and use its cardLabel as a present() value, not absent() -- consistent with how the existing 'consumed' (0%) case already uses present('0%') for a definite-but-non-standard outcome.
hauska-map.buildable-display-vocab.ts: mapBuildableDisplay's FIRST check is `if (decline === 'atom_path_pending') return kind:'loading'` unconditionally -- this must not regress for the true loading case (no geometry yet). Plan: add a new check immediately BEFORE it, `if (decline === 'atom_path_pending' && input.hasGeometry === true)`, returning a new 'modelled-figure-withheld' token. This is additive; the existing loading-shell test coverage for the no-geometry case is unaffected because hasGeometry defaults to undefined/false for every existing caller.
